note: Made up for the treesight README demo. No real person, project or session. Times are UTC.

events.text: Let's add photo upload to recipe-box. One photo per recipe is enough for now, shown at the top of the recipe page.
Read app/routes/recipes.py
Write app/routes/photos.py
Photo upload is in. Each recipe page now has an Upload photo button, and the photo shows at the top of the recipe. All 22 tests pass, including 4 new ones for uploads.
Uploading a photo from my phone fails. Small test images work, but a real photo just says Upload failed.
Grep upload_limit
The web server rejects uploads over 1 MB, and photos from a phone are usually 3 to 6 MB. Raising the limit in the server config should fix it.
Raise it to 10 MB.
Done: the server now accepts uploads up to 10 MB. Try your phone photo again.
Still failing, same message.
You're adding photo upload to recipe-box. Phone photos still fail after the server limit went up to 10 MB; next is finding what else rejects them.
Found a second limit: the app itself also capped uploads at 1 MB. I raised it to 10 MB as well and added a test that uploads a 6 MB photo.
Works now. A 6 MB photo from my phone uploaded fine.
The photo shows up sideways though.
Phones save the rotation as a separate tag instead of turning the pixels, and the page ignored that tag. I now turn each photo the right way up when it is uploaded.
Perfect, it's the right way up now.
Sam has the keys for the photo storage bucket. I asked him this morning and he said he'd send them this week. Until then photos stay on the server's disk.
OK. Photos stay on disk for now, and once Sam's keys arrive I'll move them to the bucket.
Lena is checking the new photo layout on her phone. I'll wait for her feedback before the release.
Got it: the release waits for Lena's feedback on the layout.
Shrinking photos before saving would be nice, but let's leave that until after the launch.
Noted: shrinking photos is for after the launch.
I want to demo recipe-box at the web meetup on September 20. I'll sign up for a demo slot this week.
Good luck with the demo. Photo upload should make a nice one.
One more thing: deleting a recipe should delete its photo too.
Noted: deleting a recipe should also remove its photo. It isn't done yet.
Add photo upload to recipes
